title: Galilean Reeh-Schlieder obstruction in the vacuum and the thermal Reeh-Schlieder property
summary: We ask in which states, and for which local algebras, Galilean quantum fields have the Reeh-Schlieder property. The nets are generated by time-zero canonical fields on spatial regions and by the dynamics. The Bargmann mass over the charge of the field is a number operator for the time-zero fields, bounded from below by positivity of the energy and boost covariance, and Chaiken's theorem gives Galilean Fock rigidity: these fields form a direct sum of Fock representations, and the time-zero annihilation fields annihilate every translation-invariant vector.
